_note: Manual single-coder classification by the challenge-208 reviewer of each NON-SURVIVED science claim's verdict reason(s). A = numbers/arithmetic reproduce from stated inputs, the inference/scope/proxy/wording overreaches. B = a stated number, input reading, or factual premise is itself wrong or unreproducible. C = defect is only evidence-level or provenance labelling. N = a negative/absence statement (or its search scope) is wrong; includes claims that were too pessimistic. Judgement calls, not measurements.
